quarterly_data.signal: NEC signed a supply contract with a consortium of companies, including Lightstorm, Microsoft, Singtel and Tata Communications, for the India-Southeast Asia (I-2SEA) submarine fiber-optic cable system connecting India, Malaysia and Singapore: approximately 3,600 km, directly linking areas of AI and hyperscaler data centers in Hyderabad and Chennai with Singapore and Kuala Lumpur; operations are scheduled to begin in 2029. Tomonori Uematsu (Corporate SVP, Head of Submarine Network Division): NEC has over 60 years of experience in the submarine cable systems business and has laid more than 450,000 km of submarine cables.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 3,600 km; operations scheduled from 2029; more than 450,000 km of submarine cables laid to date
quarterly_data.counterparty: I-2SEA consortium (including Lightstorm, Microsoft, Singtel and Tata Communications)
